message:
Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import json,os
trace=[
 {"step":1,"file":"src-vul/h5_read_fuzzer.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":13,"var":"data[0] / size","code":"if (size == 0) return 0; uint8_t decider = data[0]; size -= 1; data += 1;","note":"The first byte is attacker-controlled but ignored by the target logic; the remaining bytes become the file contents written to disk."},
 {"step":2,"file":"src-vul/h5_read_fuzzer.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":20,"var":"data,size","code":"fwrite(data, size, 1, fp);","note":"The remaining input bytes are copied verbatim into a temporary file, so the attacker fully controls the HDF5 file image."},
 {"step":3,"file":"src-vul/h5_read_fuzzer.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":23,"var":"filename","code":"H5Fopen(filename, H5F_ACC_RDONLY, H5P_DEFAULT);","note":"The crafted file is parsed by HDF5 in read-only mode, entering the object-header and message decoding paths."},
 {"step":4,"file":"src-vul/hdf5/src/H5S.c","function":"H5S_read","line":1117,"var":"ds->extent","code":"if (NULL == H5O_msg_read(loc, H5O_SDSPACE_ID, &(ds->extent)))","note":"Opening a dataset causes HDF5 to read the dataspace message from the object header into ds->extent."},
 {"step":5,"file":"src-vul/hdf5/src/H5Omessage.c","function":"H5O_msg_read","line":436,"var":"loc->addr / type_id","code":"H5O_protect(loc, H5AC__READ_ONLY_FLAG, FALSE); ... H5O_msg_read_oh(loc->file, oh, type_id, mesg)","note":"The object header is protected and the requested message type is dispatched to the message-specific decoder."},
 {"step":6,"file":"src-vul/hdf5/src/H5Omessage.c","function":"H5O_msg_read_oh","line":513,"var":"oh->mesg[idx].native","code":"H5O_LOAD_NATIVE(f, 0, oh, &(oh->mesg[idx]), NULL)","note":"If the dataspace message has not yet been decoded, HDF5 invokes the H5O_SDSPACE_ID decode callback on attacker-controlled raw bytes."},
 {"step":7,"file":"src-vul/hdf5/src/H5Opkg.h","function":"<global>","line":163,"var":"MSG->native / MSG->raw","code":"H5O_LOAD_NATIVE(...) -> (msg_type->decode)((F), (OH), (MSG)->flags, &ioflags, (MSG)->raw_size, (MSG)->raw)","note":"The decoder receives the raw message buffer and its declared size; malformed length fields can make later reads go past the allocated raw buffer."},
 {"step":8,"file":"src-vul/hdf5/src/H5S.c","function":"H5S_read","line":1117,"var":"ds->extent","code":"H5O_msg_read(loc, H5O_SDSPACE_ID, &(ds->extent))","note":"The vulnerable sink is a heap-buffer-overflow read during dataspace-message decoding, triggered while opening the crafted file."}
]
open('/workspace/candidate_trace.json','w').write(json.dumps(trace,indent=2))
print('wrote trace')
PY
bash submit.sh /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/h5_read_fuzzer.c /workspace/candidate_trace.json
